conclusion: Invoice ORC1021 belongs to the period ending 30 September 2026: no contract is linked, and service completion record SR-ORC1021 shows the service provided from 1 to 30 September 2026 and confirmed complete on 30 September 2026; control of a service provided through the month transfers over time as it is provided, all within the period.

reasoning_chain.text: Invoice ORC1021 for 55000 cents was posted on 17 September 2026.
Service completion record SR-ORC1021 shows the service starting on 1 September 2026 and confirmed complete on 30 September 2026.
Revenue is recognised when (or as) the customer obtains control of the promised good or service (AASB 15 para 31).
Control of a service transfers over time when the customer simultaneously receives and consumes the benefits as the entity performs (AASB 15 para 35(a)).

With no contract linked, the service-completion record sets the transfer: the customer received the service through September and confirmed it complete on 30 September 2026, within the period, so the invoice is recorded in the correct period.

counter_argument: A service record showing that the billed service continued after 30 September 2026, or no record of the service at all, would change the conclusion.
